facts.fact: Mauritius's report to the UN disability committee says Section 23 of the Copyright Act 2014 permits reproduction of published works in accessible format for people with visual impairment and the print disabled, incorporating the Marrakesh Treaty provisions.

The Government of Mauritius says its Ministry of Social Integration set up a disability website, disability.govmu.org, where persons with disabilities can apply online for ministry services, with special features for persons with visual impairment.

The Government of Mauritius says the Mauritius Broadcasting Corporation, with the Ministry of Social Integration, provides an 8 to 10-minute news bulletin in Mauritian Sign Language, and broadcast a daily COVID-19 sign-language video during lockdown.
facts.system: MBC Mauritian Sign Language news bulletin

facts.fact: The Government of Mauritius says the National Computer Board has sets of 3D printed objects with Braille spelling and topographic maps for visually impaired persons attending the Lois Lagesse Centre and Lizie dan la Main.

systems.owner: Ministry of Social Integration, Social Security and National Solidarity
